# msl_streams (Data Source)

Lists MSL5 **Streams** (`/api/v1/streams`), optionally filtered by contract and group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `contract_id` (String) Filter streams by Akamai contract ID.
- `group_id` (String) Filter streams by group ID.

### Read-Only

- `streams` (Attributes List) List of streams matching the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--streams))

<a id="nestedatt--streams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `streams`

Read-Only:

- `backup_ingest_location` (String) Backup ingest zone.
- `backup_publishing_url` (String) Backup publishing URL.
- `contract_id` (String) Akamai contract ID.
- `cptag` (String) CP code tag.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) User who created the stream.
- `description` (String) Stream description.
- `format` (String) Streaming format (HLS, CMAF, DASH).
- `group_id` (String) Group identifier.
- `host_name` (String) Primary encoder hostname.
- `id` (String) Stream ID.
- `ingest_location` (String) Primary ingest zone.
- `origin_id` (String) ID of the linked origin.
- `playlist_duration_in_min` (Number) DVR window in minutes.
- `primary_publishing_url` (String) Primary publishing URL.
- `status` (String) Current stream status.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-updated timestamp.
